mallee-tourist-heritage-centre.name: Mallee Tourist and Heritage Centre
mallee-tourist-heritage-centre.bio: Pinnaroo museum of restored engines, farm memorabilia, a grain collection and working letterpress printing presses.

notes.pin: Railway Terrace South, Pinnaroo (address from Southern Mallee listing); pin the centre building.
notes.cost: Adult $7, concession $6 per History SA Network listing. Volunteer-run; Southern Mallee page says open about 10am-1pm Mon-Fri, so a visit window matters (not in bio, no room).
notes.ticket: Southern Mallee tourism page titled Mallee Tourist & Heritage Centre loads; the council page (southernmallee.sa.gov.au) is Cloudflare-blocked.

coonalpyn-silo-art.name: Coonalpyn Downs Silo Art
coonalpyn-silo-art.bio: Guido van Helten's 2017 mural of five local children on working grain silos beside the Dukes Highway.
coonalpyn-silo-art.ticket_note: No single official site; council page (coorong.sa.gov.au Creating Coonalpyn) is Cloudflare-blocked, so no verified link.

notes.pin: Coonalpyn silos beside the Dukes Highway; large parking area adjacent (Atlas Obscura); use the silo group, not town centre.
notes.bio: Dropped draft 'picnic area' claim: no source describes one at the silos. Silos are still operational with heavy truck traffic at times.

tauragat-hill.name: Tauragat Hill
tauragat-hill.bio: Gentle, unmarked bush trails climb to a survey marker with views over Coonalpyn and the surrounding farmland.
tauragat-hill.ticket_note: No official steward site; SATC listing only.

notes.pin: Summit survey marker; hill lies a short drive east of Tauragat Well along Tauragat Well Road, Coonalpyn. Pin on summit (OSM natural=peak/viewpoint if named).

mount-boothby-conservation-park.name: Mount Boothby Conservation Park
mount-boothby-conservation-park.bio: Park named for a 129 m granite and limestone outcrop, with wild orchids in spring and a picnic area at Boothby Rocks.
mount-boothby-conservation-park.ticket_note: No page found on parks.sa.gov.au (slugs mount-boothby-conservation-park, mount-boothby, boothby all 404).

notes.pin: Tolmer Rocks outcrop (Tolmer Rocks Road, ~20 km from Tintinara) is the 129 m feature and the same listing; Boothby Rocks Reserve picnic area off Boothby Road, Culburra is an alternative visitor point. Wikipedia park coord 35.8405 S 139.7770 E is a centroid-type point.
notes.cost: SATC lists both Mount Boothby and Tolmer Rocks as Free. parks.sa.gov.au has no page for this park at tested slugs, so no entry-fee confirmation from the agency.
notes.merge: Tolmer Rocks is covered by this entry, not a separate spot.

karte-conservation-park.name: Karte Conservation Park
karte-conservation-park.bio: Sand-dune scrub with a 1.5 km interpretive walk and picnic area, in habitat used by threatened malleefowl.

notes.pin: Walking trail (1.5 km) starts near picnic area and campsites; pin midpoint of trail (OSM) or trailhead/picnic area.
notes.cost: parks.sa.gov.au lists only accommodation fee ($15.40 per night); no vehicle entry fee, no staffed gate. Page title checked: Karte Conservation Park.

ngarkat-conservation-park.name: Ngarkat Conservation Park
ngarkat-conservation-park.bio: Remote 4WD-only mallee heath wilderness with 11 campgrounds and 10 walking trails across 271,000 hectares.

notes.pin: Park is 271,000 ha; centroid is wrong. Use a main visitor point on the Ngarkat Highway side (e.g. a campground or the Box Flat ruins / Gosse Hill walk start from the park's map).
notes.cost: parks.sa.gov.au: vehicle entry $14.40 per vehicle, camping from $23.10 per night; 4WD only; fees paid before entry. Border Track one-way section closed 1 Nov-31 Mar; closed on Catastrophic fire danger days. Page title checked.

unverified: Mallee Tourist and Heritage Centre hours conflict between sources (10am-1pm Mon-Fri vs longer); adult $7 from History SA listing, not the centre itself
Mount Boothby entry free per SATC only; no parks.sa.gov.au page found
notes: Tolmer Rocks merged into Mount Boothby entry per draft. Draft Coonalpyn bio 'picnic area' removed (unsourced). No spot judged not to be added.
